notes: Godot 4.2 playable first-person mountaineering descent simulation (Long Home): plan a line, descend from summit to base camp (Forward+; main scene res://src/scenes/main.tscn). SPDX MIT (LICENSE). No third-party art, music, or font files; terrain and characters are procedural. 257 synthesized WAV sound effects generated in-repo by tools/sfx/generate.py (assets/audio/README.md); no music. Custom mountain icon.svg (md5 0f1c028aeb3cb13b740247c1269e6814), not the default Godot icon. No Git LFS, no editor .godot, no signing keystore.
